choices.text: The tokens of the answer; the model wrote none

choices.text: Input reused from the request before; nothing was reused

choices.text: Reading the 994 tokens of tools, policies and question

choices.text: Running search_help, inside the request

choices.text: Two retries after the server was overloaded
choices.why: No retry happened in this run; the SDK retries only on errors like 529.

prompt: In section 05's two runs without --stamp, why did even request 1 show 847 in c.read?

choices.why: Right. Ollama reuses what it computed while the model stays loaded.

choices.why: c.write is zero in every run; Ollama never reports one.

prompt: Why did the run with --cache --stamp read 1,909 tokens, when the runs before it read 235 and 346?

choices.why: It added a few tokens; the window is 8,192.

choices.text: Ollama forgets what it computed when a run ends
choices.why: The runs before it reused 847 tokens an earlier run had left.

choices.text: --cache and --stamp together switch reuse off
choices.why: --cache changes nothing in Ollama; the stamp alone did it.

choices.text: The front of the prompt changed on every request
choices.why: Right. Reuse keys on the exact prefix, so nothing after the stamp matched.
